tasks.description: The catalog is the foundation of the store. Merchants must be able to create, edit, and delete products. Each product has a name, description, one or more images, a price, a SKU, and a category.
acceptance_criteria: Given a merchant account, when a product is created, then it appears in the catalog.
Given a product, when its details are edited, then the changes are reflected in the catalog.

tasks.description: Each product can have one or more images. These images should be displayed on the product detail page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product with images, when the product detail page is viewed, then the images are displayed.

tasks.description: Customers must be able to search the catalog by keyword against product names and descriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when the search results are displayed, then the results include products with matching names or descriptions.

tasks.description: Search results must be filterable by category.
acceptance_criteria: Given search results, when a category filter is applied, then the results are filtered by the selected category.

tasks.description: Customers add products to a shopping cart. The cart persists across sessions for logged-in users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when it is added to the cart, then the cart is updated with the product.
Given a logged-in user, when the user logs out and logs back in, then the cart is still populated with the previously added products.

tasks.description: Customers can update the quantity of any line item or remove a line item entirely.
acceptance_criteria: Given a line item in the cart, when the quantity is updated, then the cart is updated with the new quantity.
Given a line item in the cart, when it is removed, then the cart no longer includes the line item.

tasks.description: From the cart, a customer proceeds to checkout. Checkout collects a shipping address and a billing address, shows an order summary including shipping cost and total, and requires the customer to be authenticated.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cart with products, when the customer proceeds to checkout, then the checkout page is displayed with the order summary and shipping and billing address fields.
Given a logged-out customer, when the customer attempts to proceed to checkout, then the customer is prompted to log in.

tasks.description: The platform calculates a shipping cost for an order based on the destination address and the total order weight.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order with a destination address and total order weight, when the shipping cost is calculated, then the calculated shipping cost is accurate.

tasks.description: Payment is processed through Stripe. During checkout, after the order summary, the customer enters card details and the platform charges the order total via Stripe.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid payment method, when the customer completes the payment, then the order is marked as paid.
Given an invalid payment method, when the customer attempts to complete the payment, then an error is displayed.

tasks.description: When payment succeeds, the platform creates an order record capturing the line items, addresses, shipping cost, and total. Customers can view their order history and the status of each order.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful payment, when the order is created, then the order record includes the line items, addresses, shipping cost, and total.
Given a customer, when the customer views their order history, then the order history includes all orders with their respective statuses.

tasks.description: Each product tracks an available stock quantity. When an order is placed, the stock for each purchased product is decremented.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product with available stock, when an order is placed for the product, then the available stock is decremented by the quantity ordered.

tasks.description: After an order is successfully paid, the platform sends the customer an email receipt containing the order number, line items, totals, and shipping address.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful payment, when the order is created, then an email receipt is sent to the customer with the order details.

tasks.description: Customers who have purchased a product may leave a star rating and a written review on that product's detail page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer who has purchased a product, when the customer leaves a review, then the review is displayed on the product detail page.
Given a product, when a customer views the product detail page, then the average rating and list of reviews are displayed.

tasks.description: Logged-in customers can add products to a personal wishlist and remove them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in customer, when a product is added to the wishlist, then the product is included in the customer's wishlist.
Given a logged-in customer, when a product is removed from the wishlist, then the product is no longer included in the customer's wishlist.

tasks.description: Merchants access an admin panel to manage the store. The admin panel provides product management, category management, order management, and inventory visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a merchant account, when the admin panel is accessed, then the merchant can manage products, categories, orders, and inventory.
Given a merchant, when the merchant views the admin panel, then the panel displays the store's products, categories, orders, and inventory.

tasks.description: Access to the admin panel is restricted to merchant accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a non-merchant account, when the admin panel is accessed, then an error is displayed.
Given a merchant account, when the admin panel is accessed, then the admin panel is displayed.

tasks.description: The product detail page should display all product information and images.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when the product detail page is viewed, then the page displays all product information and images.

tasks.description: The platform should be migrated to a new database to improve performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given the new database, when the platform is migrated, then the platform is using the new database.

tasks.description: The API should have documentation to help developers understand how to use it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the API, when the documentation is written, then the documentation is accurate and helpful.

tasks.description: The platform should have product categories to help customers find products.
acceptance_criteria: Given the product categories, when a customer views the categories, then the categories are displayed correctly.

tasks.description: Merchants can update an order's status.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order, when a merchant updates the order status, then the order status is updated correctly.
